ex.t: 내 삼촌은 배우인데 지금 파리에 살고 있어요.
ex.read: nae samchoneun baeuinde jigeum parie salgo isseoyo.
ex.en: My uncle, who is an actor, lives in Paris now.

ex.t: 서울은 한국의 수도이고 인구가 천만 명이에요.
ex.read: seoureun hangugui sudoigo inguga cheonman myeongieyo.
ex.en: Seoul, which is the capital of Korea, has ten million people.
This bridge, which was built in 1990, is famous.
The castle was built in the twelfth century.
The founder of the company, who is eighty, has retired.
I was born in Busan, where I also grew up.

ex.t: 그녀는 시골에서 자랐고 그곳에서 지금도 살아요.
ex.read: geunyeoneun sigoreseo jaratgo geugoseseo jigeumdo sarayo.
ex.en: She grew up in the countryside, where she still lives.
His occupation is doctor, which keeps him busy.

ex.t: 그는 늦게 일어났는데 그 때문에 기차를 놓쳤어요.
ex.read: geuneun neutge ireonanneunde geu ttaemune gichareul notchyeosseoyo.
ex.en: He got up late, which made him miss the train.

explain.ko: 한국어에서는 관계절 대신 연결 어미로 설명을 덧붙입니다. 명사 설명은 -인데: 내 삼촌은 배우인데 지금 파리에 살아요. 동사·형용사는 -는데 / -ㄴ데: 우리 가족은 여름마다 가는데 모두 좋아해요. 사실을 나열할 때는 -고: 부산에서 태어났고 거기서 자랐어요. 앞 문장을 가리킬 때는 그곳 / 거기 / 그 때문에를 씁니다.
explain.en: Korean adds extra information with connective endings rather than relative clauses. Noun: -인데: 내 삼촌은 배우인데 지금 파리에 살아요. Verb or adjective: -는데 / -ㄴ데: 우리 가족은 여름마다 가는데 모두 좋아해요. Listing facts: -고: 부산에서 태어났고 거기서 자랐어요. Refer back with 그곳 / 거기 / 그 때문에.

notes.ko: -인데는 앞의 명사를 설명하고 뒤 말을 이끕니다.
notes.en: -인데 describes the noun and leads to the next clause.

notes.ko: 그 때문에는 앞 내용이 이유일 때 씁니다.
notes.en: 그 때문에 gives the earlier clause as the reason.

lines.t: 우리 삼촌이야. 배우인데 지금 파리에 살아.
삼촌 집은 센 강 근처인데, 거기서 에펠탑이 보여.

trans.en:
A: Who is the man in this photo?
B: That's my uncle, who is an actor. He lives in Paris now.
A: Really? What's Paris like?
B: His flat is near the Seine, where you can see the Eiffel Tower.

lines.t: 저는 부산에서 태어났고 거기서 자랐어요. 부산은 한국에서 두 번째로 큰 도시인데 바다로 유명해요. 우리 가족은 매년 여름 그곳에 가요. 할머니는 지금도 거기서 사시는데 우리는 그것을 아주 좋아해요.

trans.en: I was born in Busan, where I also grew up. Busan, which is the second largest city in Korea, is famous for its sea. Our family goes there every summer. My grandmother still lives there, which we like very much.

lines.t: 성에 가려고 해요. 몇 시에 문을 열어요?

trans.en:
Guide: Tourist information.
Guest: I'd like to visit the castle. What time does it open?
Guide: The castle, which was built in the twelfth century, opens at nine.
Guest: And how much is the entrance fee?

TRAVEL GUIDE
The Colosseum, which is in the centre of Rome, was completed in AD 80. Six million people visit every year, which is one of the highest numbers in the world. In summer it's best to go early in the morning.

trans.en: Martin was born in England but moved to Korea at thirty. He teaches English in Seoul, which he enjoys a lot. His wife is Korean.
